mapper.select: SELECT id, title, image_url, link_url, sort_order, is_active, create_time FROM banner ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO banner (title, image_url, link_url, sort_order, is_active) VALUES (#{title}, #{imageUrl}, #{linkUrl}, #{sortOrder}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE banner SET is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
